prompt: Modern 3D animated character group shot, Pixar style, diverse group of animated kid characters different genders playing together, stylized, vibrant colors, cinematic 3D render, include a title

plan.rationale: This piece aims to capture a vibrant, modern scene of diverse animated kids playing together, inspired by Pixar's style. The group shot will feature a balanced, varied cast of characters, each with distinct, yet harmonious, personalities. The title will be concise and eye-catching, ensuring it doesn't overshadow the main subject.

elements.content: A diverse group of animated kids in playful poses, each wearing unique but colorful outfits, laughing and interacting in a park setting. The environment includes stylized trees and a clear blue sky with fluffy clouds.
elements.image_prompt: A group of diverse animated kids in a park, playing and laughing, with colorful outfits and a clear blue sky.

elements.content: A title card with the text 'Play Together, Dream Bigger' in a bold, modern font, slightly off-center and partially visible in the background, blending seamlessly with the scene.
elements.image_prompt: Title card: 'Play Together, Dream Bigger' in a bold, modern font, with a hint of the animated kids' laughter and play in the background.
